newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics expands switch product line.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics expands switch product line.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Monday it had added new management products for its line of local area network (LAN) switching hubs.

The company said its TOTALswitch Manager 97 provides a full range of network management options, including a system for monitoring and isolating network problems. The product will ship in January with a list price of $495.
Other new products include a Web agent for use by network participants in need of Web-based management and a remote network monitoring capability through a software upgrade.
U.S. Robotics supplies hardware and software that improves access to information, including switches and modems.
Its stock was up one point at 72-3/4.
